title: Page 175
transc:
Fortress Monroe May 30 / 64
Nelly for pilgrim E. S. Allen a vincent grapes
unity have not a wayworner or pilot in soap
zebra more than half of our weaselers have to
run without pilots up the York zodiac have sent
for all the York and pair monkey windsor pilots
that I can hear of which has been few
unity some of shelter benhams boats are here pekin
whistles have orders not to disembark anywhere till arrival
of shelby benham zebra tell shelter rucker will return
the city of Albany and ranger soon as I
can get hold of them walrus Biggs chief vincent
Geo. D. Sheldon
